caption:
Coca-Cola just finished shaking up its global marketing setup by bringing in Omnicom for North America and trimming down thousands of old agencies. For years, the team chased vague feelings of brand love until they realized bank accounts prefer actual sales. 🥤

When was the last time a brand made you buy something just by being cute on Twitter?

@cocacola

Source: Marketing Dive

post.news: Coca-Cola selected Omnicom as its North American media agency, wrapping up a massive global marketing makeover that cut thousands of agencies.
post.take: Turns out begging people to love your logo doesn't pay the bills quite like selling them actual drinks.
post.insight: Coca-Cola moved away from brand love as its main metric, focusing instead on total consumer growth and digital media to drive real business results.
